rec-1.title: Palak Paneer
instructions: Blanch spinach leaves and puree with ginger and garlic
Heat butter in a pan and sauté onions until golden
Add tomatoes, cumin, and garam masala, cook until soft
Add spinach puree and simmer for 10 minutes
Add paneer cubes and cook for 5 minutes
Serve hot with rice or roti

rec-2.title: Grilled Chicken
instructions: Mix yogurt with spices, ginger, garlic, and lemon juice
Marinate chicken pieces for at least 2 hours
Preheat grill to medium-high heat
Grill chicken for 15-20 minutes until internal temp reaches 165°F
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving
Serve with salad and dip

rec-3.title: Creamy Pasta Alfredo
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions
In a pan, melt butter and sauté minced garlic
Add milk, bring to a simmer, then stir in grated cheese until melted
Toss cooked pasta and sautéed bell peppers in the sauce
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with parsley and serve hot

rec-4.title: Fresh Garden Salad
instructions: Chop all vegetables into bite-size pieces
Mix vegetables in a large bowl
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the salad
Add salt and pepper to taste
Toss well to combine
Serve immediately

rec-5.title: Chicken Biryani
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices for 30 minutes
Cook rice until 70% done, drain and set aside
Fry sliced onions until golden brown
In a pot, layer marinated chicken, then rice, then fried onions
Cover and cook on low heat for 25 minutes, then let it rest for 5 minutes
Mix gently and serve hot with raita

rec-6.title: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Prepare pizza dough and let it rise for 1 hour
Roll out dough into a circle and spread tomato sauce evenly
Add mozzarella cheese generously
Drizzle with garlic butter
Bake at 450°F for 12-15 minutes
Slice and serve hot

rec-7.title: Tom Yum Soup
instructions: Boil water with ginger and garlic
Add fish pieces and cook for 5 minutes
Add tomatoes and red chili, simmer for 10 minutes
Add lemon juice before serving
Garnish with coriander
Serve hot

rec-8.title: Grilled Steak
instructions: Season beef with salt, pepper, and garlic
Let it rest at room temperature for 30 minutes
Preheat grill to high heat and grill steak for 4-5 minutes per side
Add butter on top while resting
Let rest for 5 minutes
Slice and serve with vegetables

rec-9.title: Sushi Rolls
instructions: Cook sushi rice and season with vinegar
Slice fish and vegetables into thin strips
Place nori sheet on bamboo mat and spread rice evenly
Add fish and vegetables in the center
Roll tightly using the mat
Slice into pieces and serve with soy sauce

rec-10.title: Classic Burger
instructions: Form beef into patties and season well
Grill patties for 4 minutes per side
Toast burger buns lightly and add cheese on patty in last minute
Assemble: bun, patty, tomato, onion
Add your favorite sauce
Serve with fries

rec-11.title: Dal Tadka
instructions: Pressure cook lentils with turmeric until soft
Heat butter in a pan and splutter cumin seeds
Add chopped onions, ginger, garlic, and tomatoes, cook until soft
Add red chili and other spices to complete tempering
Pour this tempering over cooked lentils
Simmer for 5 minutes and serve hot with rice

rec-12.title: Paneer Tikka
instructions: Cut paneer and vegetables into cubes
Mix yogurt with all spices, ginger, garlic, and lemon juice
Marinate paneer and vegetables for 1 hour
Thread onto skewers alternating paneer and vegetables
Grill or bake at 400°F for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally
Serve hot with mint chutney

rec-13.title: Idli & Sambar
instructions: Soak rice and lentils separately for 4-6 hours
Grind into a smooth batter and ferment overnight
Steam batter in idli molds for 10-12 minutes
Cook lentils with vegetables and tamarind pulp for sambar
Prepare tempering with mustard seeds and curry leaves, add to sambar
Serve hot idlis with sambar and coconut chutney

rec-14.title: Bisi Bele Bath
instructions: Cook rice and lentils together until soft
Sauté vegetables with bisi bele bath spice powder
Add tamarind pulp and salt
Mix cooked rice and lentils with vegetables
Add grated coconut and simmer for 5 minutes
Top with ghee and serve hot with papadum

rec-15.title: Chicken Chettinad
instructions: Roast dry spices and coconut, then grind into a paste
Heat oil and sauté onions, curry leaves, and ginger-garlic paste
Add tomatoes and cook until soft
Add chicken pieces and the prepared spice paste
Cook until chicken is tender and gravy thickens
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot with paratha or rice

rec-16.title: Ven Pongal
instructions: Dry roast moong dal until golden
Wash and cook rice and dal together in a pressure cooker until soft and mushy
Heat butter, splutter mustard seeds, cumin, curry leaves, and ginger
Add cashews and fry until golden
Pour the tempering over the pongal, mix well, and season with salt and pepper
Serve piping hot with coconut chutney and sambar

rec-17.title: Crispy Dosa & Coconut Chutney
instructions: Soak rice and lentils for 6-8 hours, grind into a batter, and ferment overnight
For chutney: blend coconut, green chili, and ginger into a paste
Prepare tempering with mustard seeds and curry leaves for the chutney
Heat a flat griddle until very hot, pour a ladle of batter, and spread thinly
Drizzle oil on edges and cook until golden and crispy
Serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar

rec-18.title: Rava Upma
instructions: Dry roast sooji on low heat until fragrant and set aside
Heat butter, splutter mustard seeds, cumin, curry leaves, green chili, and ginger
Add chopped onion, tomatoes, and diced vegetables, cook until soft
Add boiling water and salt, bring to a boil
Add roasted rava slowly while stirring continuously to avoid lumps
Cover and cook on low heat for 5 minutes, serve hot with coconut chutney

rec-19.title: Medu Vada
instructions: Soak urad dal for 3-4 hours, drain, and grind into a thick, fluffy batter
Add finely chopped onion, ginger, curry leaves, cumin, and salt
Mix vigorously to incorporate air, heat oil in a deep pan to 180°C
Shape batter into a donut shape with wet hands
Slide into hot oil and fry until golden brown, flipping once
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with chutney and sambar

rec-20.title: Puttu & Kadala Curry
instructions: Soak black chickpeas overnight and pressure cook until soft
Mix rice flour with grated coconut and salt, steam in slightly moist layers
For curry: heat oil, splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves
Sauté onions, ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, and spices until thick
Add cooked chickpeas and coconut milk, simmer for 10 minutes
Garnish with coriander and serve steamed puttu with the rich kadala curry

rec-21.title: Chettinad Fish Curry
instructions: Extract tamarind juice and grind roasted spices and coconut into a paste
Heat sesame oil, splutter mustard seeds, fenugreek, curry leaves, and garlic
Sauté onions and tomatoes until mushy
Pour in tamarind extract, ground masala, and simmer until oil separates
Gently slide in washed fish pieces and cook covered for 5-7 minutes
Serve hot with steamed rice or idli

rec-22.title: Ambur Mutton Biryani
instructions: Soak rice and pressure cook mutton with ginger-garlic paste until tender
Heat oil/ghee, sauté whole spices, onions, and freshly ground ginger-garlic paste
Add red chili paste, chopped tomatoes, yogurt, herbs, and cook until oil separates
Add cooked mutton, stock, and adjust water for the rice
Bring to a boil, add drained rice, and check for salt
Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes, rest, and serve with onion raita

rec-23.title: Nattu Kozhi Kulambu
instructions: Dry roast and powder spices, and grind coconut with shallots into a paste
Heat sesame oil, splutter mustard seeds, curry leaves, and sauté shallots
Add ginger, garlic, and tomatoes, cook until mushy
Add chicken, turmeric, salt, and spice powder, roast for 5-8 minutes
Add water and pressure cook for 4-5 whistles until chicken is tender
Add coconut paste, simmer for 5 minutes, and serve hot

rec-24.title: Pallipalayam Chicken
instructions: Grate or crush garlic cloves roughly
Heat oil, splutter mustard seeds, and sauté shallots until translucent
Add crushed garlic, curry leaves, and deseeded dry red chilies
Add chicken and turmeric, fry until chicken changes color, and cook covered
Once chicken is tender, add thinly sliced fresh coconut pieces
Roast uncovered until chicken is completely dry and serve hot

rec-25.title: Vatha Kuzhambu
instructions: Extract tamarind juice and fry dried berries in sesame oil until crisp
In the same pan, temper mustard seeds, fenugreek, curry leaves, garlic, and shallots
Add chopped tomato (optional), sambar powder, and turmeric, mixing quickly
Pour in tamarind extract, salt, and boil until the gravy thickens
Add the fried berries and jaggery, simulate until oil floats
Serve with steamed rice and poriyal

rec-26.title: Thayir Sadam (Curd Rice)
instructions: Pressure cook rice until soft and mushy, mash well while hot
Let rice cool, then mix with yogurt, milk, and salt until creamy
For tempering: heat oil, splutter mustard seeds and urad dal until golden
Add finely chopped ginger, green chilies, and curry leaves, sauté briefly
Pour tempering over curd rice and mix gently
Garnish with pomegranate or carrots, serve chilled with pickle

rec-27.title: Idiyappam & Vegetable Stew
instructions: Mix boiling water into rice flour to form a smooth dough
Squeeze dough into steamer plates and steam for 8-10 minutes
For the stew: sauté whole spices, onions, ginger, green chilies, and curry leaves
Add carrots, potatoes, peas, and thin coconut milk, cook until tender
Add thick coconut milk on low heat without boiling
Serve hot stringy idiyappam with the creamy vegetable stew

rec-28.title: Kuzhi Paniyaram
instructions: Heat oil, splutter mustard seeds and chana dal
Sauté chopped onions, green chilies, and curry leaves until golden
Mix tempered ingredients and coriander leaves into leftover idli batter
Heat a paniyaram pan, add oil, and fill each cavity 3/4th with batter
Cook covered until the bottom is crispy, then flip and cook the other side
Serve hot with spicy tomato-garlic chutney

rec-29.title: Adai & Avial
instructions: Soak rice, mixed lentils, and red chilies, then grind into a thick batter
For avial: steam mixed vegetables with turmeric until just cooked
Grind coconut, chilies, cumin, add to vegetables, and stir in yogurt and coconut oil
Heat a griddle, spread adai batter thicker than a dosa, and drizzle with oil/ghee
Cook both sides of adai until deep golden and crispy
Serve hot adai with avial and jaggery

rec-30.title: Veg Kothu Parotta
instructions: Tear cooled parottas into bite-sized pieces
Heat oil in a wide pan, temper fennel seeds, curry leaves, and sauté onions
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, mixed vegetables, and spices, cook until tender
Pour in veg salna (curry sauce) and let it bubble, then add parotta pieces
Vigorously mince and stir-fry the mixture on high heat for a few minutes
Serve hot with onion raita and an extra side of salna

rec-31.title: Madurai Kari Dosa
instructions: Prepare mutton keema sukka by sautéing spices, onions, and minced meat until dry
Beat an egg in a small bowl with a pinch of salt and pepper
Spread a thick circle of dosa batter on a hot cast iron tawa and let cook slightly
Pour the beaten egg evenly over the dosa, then spoon the cooked keema on top
Carefully flip and cook the meat-egg side on medium heat until charred
Flip back, garnish with fresh coriander, and serve hot

rec-32.title: Appam & Chicken Stew
instructions: For Appam: Grind soaked rice with grated coconut and yeast, ferment for 8 hours
For the stew: Sauté whole spices, onions, ginger, and green chilies until soft
Add chicken, potatoes, and thin coconut milk, cook until tender
Reduce heat, pour in thick coconut milk without boiling, and turn off heat
Pour appam batter into a hot appachatti, swirl to coat, and cook covered until edges are crispy
Serve hot appam with the mildly spiced, creamy chicken stew

rec-33.title: Muttai Dosa (Egg Dosa)
instructions: Spread a thin layer of dosa batter on a hot tawa
Crack an egg slightly in a bowl and pour it in the center
Spread the egg evenly over the batter
Sprinkle chopped onion, green chili, and black pepper on top
Drizzle oil on edges and cook until the bottom is crispy and egg is cooked
Fold and serve hot with chutney

rec-34.title: Chicken Keema Paratha
instructions: Sauté minced chicken with onions and spices until well cooked
Make a smooth dough from wheat flour
Roll dough into small circles and place chicken stuffing in the center
Fold the edges into a ball, sealing the stuffing inside
Roll out again gently into a paratha shape
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee on both sides until golden and serve hot
